context.batch_guidance: Evidence is precollected. Submit all current scoped classes using existing evidence IDs. No further inspections are budgeted. Partial source excerpts are NOT complete files; do not claim unseen code was inspected. Use the SAME global service labels across batches; prior accepted assignments provide context, not reference truth. Shared classes use one row with multiple labels. Allowed literal service labels: ["candidate_1", "candidate_2", "candidate_3", "candidate_4", "candidate_5"]. On unknown_or_duplicate_service findings, repair invalid or repeated labels using only that list; do not repeat the rejected submission unchanged.

model_usage.system_instruction: Return only the strict-schema action envelope with type=submit. No tool actions, extra fields, markdown or hidden reasoning. Use exact scoped class names, allowed service labels and real same-class evidence IDs. Preserve shared-class records.
model_usage.wire_instruction: Return exactly {"action":{"type":"submit","output":{"assignments":[...]}}}. Evidence is already collected; submit is the only allowed action. Cover every scoped class, cite its real evidence IDs, and use only allowed_service_labels. Multiple service labels require shared=true.
